Area.evidence_source: Alcohol had a direct or an indirect influence on the suicidal death of the decedents. Directly, it had an influence on the suicidal process by facilitating the suicidal acts; it was used as a means to suicide or had an influence on the overall life style of the individuals. Indirectly, alcohol had an influence in the suicidal process of the decedents as victims of the alcohol use by others.
